source_refs.note: Rate of Flow: a main subheading of 5.8 Steady, non-viscous and ideal fluid, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 104-104.

blocks.text: The rate of flow of a fluid through a pipe is the volume of the fluid passing through any section of pipe per unit time.
bold: The rate of flow of a fluid through a pipe is the volume of the fluid passing through any section of pipe per unit time.
